title: Three Giant Lanthanide Clusters Ln37 (Ln = Gd, Tb, and Eu) Featuring A Double-Cage Structure

synthesis.procedure: 1,2,3-Cyclohexanetriol, sodium acetate, and aqueous Gd(ClO4)3 were mixed in anhydrous ethanol and acetonitrile. Freshly prepared aqueous NaOH was added dropwise while heating and stirring at approximately 80 °C until incipient but permanent precipitation. The mixture was refluxed for 2 h, filtered, and evaporated under ambient conditions; colorless crystals formed after approximately one month.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The peanut-like double-cage core comprises two carbonate-containing Gd15 cage units linked to a Gd7 unit through carbonate and μ3-OH bridges. Cyclohexanetriol, acetate, and water ligands further stabilize the discrete Gd37 cluster.
